headline: Indonesian Gold Prices Decline While Nickel Reference Price Rises
seoTitle: Indonesia Gold Price Dip and Nickel Price Increase
metaDescription: Indonesian gold prices recorded a decline in mid-November 2026 trading, while the Ministry of ESDM announced a 4 percent increase for nickel reference prices.
aiSummaryBullets: Market data from mid-November 2026 indicates a downward trend in domestic gold prices across major retailers.
The Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources set the reference price for nickel at over 15,500 USD per ton for the second half of November.
While gold prices continue to face downward pressure, nickel recorded a 4 percent price increase during the same observation period.
aiContextParagraph: As of mid-November 2026, domestic precious metal markets in Indonesia have experienced a sustained decline in prices. Retailers including Antam, Galeri24, and UBS have reported consistent decreases in valuation across various grammages for gold. Concurrently, the Indonesian Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources (ESDM) has issued updated pricing benchmarks for mineral commodities. The Harga Mineral Acuan (HMA) for nickel has been established at 15,596.88 USD per ton for the period spanning November 15 to 30, 2026. This represents a 4 percent increase compared to previous levels. These market adjustments occur alongside broader economic indicators, including reports of Indonesia's national debt reaching 455.4 billion USD in the third quarter of 2026 and fluctuations in global oil prices. Traders and authorities continue to monitor these developments as commodity price volatility impacts various sectors of the Indonesian economy.
whyItIsViral: The story is viral due to consistent coverage by five independent media outlets and a high velocity of reporting on domestic commodity fluctuations.
